summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of School Connect MVP. 32/32 pytest cases passing covering auth (incl. mocked OTP register/verify-otp/forgot-reset), role-based access, admin analytics, teacher/student CRUD, attendance mark+replace+report, teacher homework/notes/performance, parent children/attendance/homework/results/timetable, announcements role-filtering, events, lost-and-found, profile. Frontend: login flow for all 3 roles works end-to-end, dashboards render with live data, sidebar navigation works, charts render via Recharts, data-testid attributes present. No critical bugs found.

issues: Date input uses browser-default date picker (input[type=date]) rather than a styled calendar component — minor consistency note, not blocking

console_warnings.warning: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent visual-editor instrumentation injecting span wrappers around option text, not by app source. No functional impact.

action_items: Optional: re-seed parent demo account name (it was changed to 'Parent Updated 17xx...' by the profile-update test). Either revert via DB or extend seed.run_seed to upsert demo user fields.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login() leaks fresh OTP in HTTP detail when user not verified (line 120) — OK for MVP/mocked flow, but should be removed before production wiring real email.
forgot-password endpoint also returns otp_debug — explicitly mocked behaviour, acceptable per spec but must be gated when email integration lands.
seed_admin / run_seed should be idempotent for the demo accounts' name/password — currently profile updates persist across restarts because seed only inserts when missing.
Models accept role='admin' in /api/auth/register — public registration of admins is a security concern; restrict role to ['teacher','parent'] in RegisterRequest.
No rate-limit / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook expectation: lockout after 5 fails).
JWT stored in localStorage ('sc_token') — XSS exposure; httpOnly cookie was specified in playbook but not implemented.
test_credentials: admin@school.com/admin123, teacher@school.com/teacher123, parent@school.com/parent123 — all verified working
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (13 students, 5 teachers, 3 parent users, 14 days attendance, 3 homework, etc.). Test-created TEST_ records were cleaned up by their tests; one TEST_Quiz performance entry remains for Alex Doe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend MVP fully working. /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite (run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v). Public URL: https://connect-school-2.preview.emergentagent.com. JWT stored in localStorage as 'sc_token'. OTP flow MOCKED — backend returns otp_debug field. The parent demo user's display name was modified by the profile-update test; consider making seed idempotent or filter the update test to a throwaway account.
